game.name: F1 2013 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
game.desc: F1 2013 is a Formula 1 simulation available on Xbox 360. The player can experience his own career alongside the current drivers or take part in legendary races against Nigel Mansell, Damon Hill, Michael Schumacher or Alain Prost. Circuits such as Brands Hatch and Jerez are also playable.
